_note: Physical mailboxes on the website (Peter, Nov 15 2026). Owners edit prices, box number ranges and the address here. Terms are 6 months or a year. reminder_days: how many days before the paid-through date a renewal reminder goes out (60 = the last two months, 30 = the last month, 7 = the last week, Peter Nov 17 2026); one more goes out the day after it lapses. They go out by text and email every morning on the live site (src/worker.ts), or when staff press Send due reminders.
_hold_note: After a box ends (it expired, or staff closed it), keep the holder's mail for hold_months, then return it to sender. Ended boxes stay on the staff Expired list for keep_months; search finds them after that too (Peter, Nov 16 2026).
_mail_note: Mail log (Peter, Nov 16 2026): capacity is how many pieces (letters and packages) a box holds before each extra piece costs overage_fee. Overages are charged to the card on file once they reach min_charge (Stripe's smallest charge is 50 cents); without a card they are paid at the counter.
_package_note: Packages (Peter, Nov 16 2026) don't count toward capacity (that's letters). Up to package_free_count packages at a time are free; each one past that costs package_fee if it's still here package_fee_after_days days after it came in. Every package is free for package_free_days days, then storage_fee_per_day each day until it's picked up, never more than storage_cap per package. On day package_return_notice_day the holder gets a final notice; package_return_after_notice_days later staff see Return to sender. A pickup reminder goes out package_remind_day days after it came in.
_check_note: Boxes whose letters have sat check_every_days without anyone checking go on the staff Check these boxes list (Peter, Nov 16 2026).
